evidence_hierarchy.submission_confirmed: original six-panel programme and centered-shape audit on main
evidence_hierarchy.post_freeze_localization: original archive stress tests plus same-source Nyctalus mechanism localization
evidence_hierarchy.prospective_external: response-unopened external sources under fully frozen protocols

original_submission.strongest_statement: Repeatable vertical individual organization extends beyond coarse horizontal occupancy, and five comparative panels retain identity in centered distribution shape.

context_localization.synthesis: measured context allocation does not explain the signal away where the Nyctalus signal is present

prospective_external_summary.generality_status: centered vertical individuality is recurrent but not universal across tested bat systems

current_general_ecological_synthesis.name: orthogonal / axis-specific spatial individuality
current_general_ecological_synthesis.statement: Horizontal site fidelity, absolute vertical level, and centered vertical-distribution shape are separable dimensions of individual spatial organization.
key_boundary_evidence: original comparative systems retain vertical identity after coarse horizontal occupancy matching
Tadarida separates absolute vertical level from centered vertical shape
Hipposideros shows strong horizontal foraging-site fidelity without source-level centered vertical identity

current_mechanistic_synthesis.name: context-residual individuality where present
current_mechanistic_synthesis.statement: When centered vertical individuality is present, measured movement/place/resource context may fail to explain it away; this is not a universal bat mechanism.

strongest_general_statement: Different dimensions of individual spatial specialization can dissociate. Centered vertical individuality occurs in multiple bat systems but is not universal across tested independent sources.
remaining_questions: what predicts whether centered vertical individuality emerges at all
what generates within-context vertical individuality where it occurs
whether detailed morphology, fine local atmosphere, exact resource geometry, memory or experience explain cross-system heterogeneity

programme_status.next_progress: new independent comparative systems or new field data
